title: Mine
wikitext:
{{Redirect|Mines|areas in Act 4|the Mines}}

{{Redirect|Remote Mine|the support gem formerly named "Remote Mine Support"|Blastchain Mine Support}}

A '''mine''' (or '''remote mine''') is a type of [[proxy]]. Mine [[skills]] throw a device that uses that skill when detonated. Placed mines [[Reservation|reserve]] mana while placed and most mines create an [[aura]] that affects nearby enemies.

==Mechanics==
===Throwing mines===
When a [[character]] uses a mine skill, they throw the mine(s) to the target location. Throwing a mine counts as using a skill, but not as casting or attacking. 

Characters have a base mine throwing speed of 0.3 seconds. When multiple mines are thrown in a single action, the throwing time is increased based on the number of additional mines - stats that grant additional mines show help text stating ''{{c|help|(Throwing Mines takes 10% more time for each additional Mine thrown)}}''.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2735477/page/1#p22821668</ref>

Throwing a mine uses mana and reserves an amount of mana, indicated by the skill's mana reservation. The mine will continue to reserve mana until it is detonated or destroyed.

Once a thrown mine lands on the ground it becomes invisible to enemies. This is mostly relevant to [[PvP]] since there are no [[monster]]s that use mines.

All mine skills, except those supported by {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}}, create mines with an [[aura]] that becomes active while those mines are placed and alive. The effects of these auras stack cumulatively, up to a limit specified by the skill. These auras are affected by aura modifiers. They have a base radius of 3.5 [[distance|metres]] and are scaled by modifiers to area, including those specific to auras.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3324396/page/2#p24823327</ref> 

Mines remain active for a limited duration, after which they expire. Mine duration is specific to each mine skill. If a mine is not detonated before it expires, it is destroyed. Mine duration is not affected by skill effect duration modifiers. Likewise, mine duration modifiers do not affect the duration of skill effects created by mines.

* Mines will be destroyed if they take any damage.
* Mines cannot be targeted directly, but they are vulnerable to [[area of effect]] damage.
* Mines cannot be damaged while they are traveling through the air, or while they are detonating.
* Mines are invulnerable for 2 seconds after they have been thrown.<ref>{{section link|Version_3.16.0|Clever_Construction}}</ref>

There is a limit on the number of mines a character can have active at one time. By default, a character can have 15 mines active at once. Throwing an additional mine that would exceed the active mine limit will cause the oldest mine to be destroyed. There are passive skills that can increase this limit.

===Detonating mines===
[[File:Detonate mines action.jpg|thumb|The Detonate Mines action appears above the skill bar.]]

While the player's character has any mines active, the [[Detonate Mines]] action (mapped to {{key press|D}} by default) becomes available. Using the Detonate Mines action initiates a detonation sequence starting with the mine closest to the target location. The detonation sequence detonates the first mine instantly, then after a brief delay, another mine within a short range of the previous one will also be detonated. This continues in an accelerating fashion, where the delay between detonating the next mine decreases each time. Once there are no more mines within proximity to the last one detonated, the detonation sequence will stop.

The mine skill gem will state what its Base Mine Detonation Time is, and that time is modified by Detonation Speed modifiers. Each successive mine detonation in a given detonation sequence has 10% More Detonation Speed. 

{{math|formula=
\text{Mine Detonation Time} = {\frac{\text{Base Detonation Time} }{(1 + \text{Increased Mine Detonation Speed}) \times (1 + 0.1 \times {(\text{Mine in Sequence} - 2 ) } ) } }
}}

The Detonate Mines action is instant and can be used while performing another action, such as throwing a mine or moving. The Detonate Mines action has a 0.2 second cooldown, after which it may be used again to start another detonation sequence. A character can have multiple detonation sequences occurring simultaneously.

Mines can be detonated while in the air. It is not necessary to wait until a mine lands on the ground before it can be detonated.

Mines can also be detonated using the {{il|Detonate Mines}} skill gem. This skill initiates a detonation sequence, just like the Detonate Mines action. The Detonate Mines skill and the Detonate Mines action both share the same cooldown, meaning that when either one is used, ''both'' will be placed on cooldown.

Mines detonated by [[Summon Skitterbots|Skitterbots]] do not initiate a detonation sequence.

===Mine skill use===
Mines release their skill effect almost immediately after their detonation, then finish the rest of their attack or cast time, then die or re-arm. This means that although attack/cast speed modifiers are generally not as useful for mine skills, they still have some function. For example, a faster use time will allow mines to re-arm/detonate an additional time sooner, and a slower use time will allow them to stay alive longer to enable leech with {{il|Machina Mitts}}. 

Mines have a targeting radius of 6 metres. This is a maximum; mines do not target enemies outside the range of their skill, which may be smaller.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1676002/filter-account-type/staff/page/2#p13452186</ref>

===Mines as separate entities===
Like other [[proxies]], mines are separate entities that use the player's skill, and that skill contains the player stats. This includes modifiers to damage, debuffs, and practically all on-hit effects, such as {{c|mod|Curse Enemies with Frostbite on Hit}}. The skill does not contain effects that specifically check the character, such as most on-kill effects. 

====Gaining on hit or on kill====
Because mines are separate entities, they cannot normally grant the player effects on [[hit]] or on [[kill]]. For example, a character will not gain [[life]], [[mana]] or [[power charge]]s when mines kill enemies cursed with {{il|Assassin's Mark}}. They also cannot benefit from effects like [[leech]], except with the specific {{c|mod|#% of Damage dealt by your Mines is Leeched to you as Life}} stat found on {{il|Machina Mitts}}. 

This separation can also be favorable, as [[damage reflection]] will deal damage to the mine and not the player. 

Due to a long-standing bug, enemies killed by (most) damage over time effects are attributed to the character, even when applied by a mine.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794</ref> This may be used to intentionally obtain on-kill effects, for example by focusing on {{stl|Poison}}, or using {{il|Southbound}} and finishing enemies off with a small {{stl|Ignite}}. 

===Other interactions===

====Trigger effects====
Mines cannot be thrown by any [[trigger]] effects. Mine skills cannot be supported by trigger gems, such as {{il|Cast when Damage Taken Support}}. Because mines can only possess one of the player's skills, their skill cannot trigger other skills, such as {{il|Impending Doom Support}}. 

====Self-cast support gems====
Mine skills cannot be supported by support gems that require spells to be cast, such as {{il|Spell Echo Support}}.

====Traps and totems====
Rather bizarrely, mines can create traps and totems. For example, {{il|Siege Ballista}} supported by {{il|Trap Support}} and {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}} will result in a skill that throws a mine. When detonated, the mine lays a trap. When triggered, the trap places a Siege Ballista totem. The skill used by the totem will not be affected by modifiers to trap or mine damage, nor will it be considered part of a mine detonation sequence.

====Cooldowns====
Mine skills can be given a [[cooldown]], for example through the use of {{il|Black Zenith}} or by supporting a skill which has a cooldown with {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}}. A mine skill will inherit the cooldown and number of uses from the skill it supports, and it can be given additional uses, such as through {{il|Second Wind Support}} or the notable passive skill [[Overprepared]] when linked to a trap skill. The number of mines thrown by each skill use is limited by the number of uses it currently has left, even if the character has a source of "Skills throw additional mines" from {{il|Minefield Support}} or items such as {{il|Curtain Call}}. 

As a proxy, the mine thrown by the character will have the same cooldown and maximum number of uses as the character, but it will be thrown with only one cooldown use of its skill, even if it has multiple maximum uses. A mine can gain additional uses over its lifetime if it is not detonated. Detonating a mine while wielding {{il|Tremor Rod}} can result in a mine with no cooldown uses remaining due to the mod {{c|mod|Mines can be Detonated an additional time}}, a mine with no cooldown uses remaining will stay placed on the ground but won't be able to detonate until enough time passes that its cooldown recovers.

==Skill gems==
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=(items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Mine") OR items.name="Detonate Mines"}} [[skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Mine (gem tag)|Mine]] [[gem tag]]: 
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=
    (
      items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
      AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Mine"
    )
    OR items.name="Detonate Mines"
}}

|tables = item_stats

}}

==Passive skills==
The damage of mines is affected by passive skills according to their other keywords (e.g. Fire) as normal. Additionally the following passive skills affect mines specifically:

===Mine damage===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_damage_+%"
}}

===Mine critical strike chance===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_critical_strike_chance_+%"
}}

===Mine critical strike multiplier===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_critical_strike_multiplier_+"
}}

===Mine throwing speed===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_laying_speed_+%"
}}

===Mine detonation speed===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_detonation_speed_+%"
}}

===Mine duration===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "mine_duration_+%"
}}

===Maximum number of mines allowed===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 passive_skill_stats.id = "number_of_additional_remote_mines_allowed"
}}

===Other===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%mine%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("mine_damage_+%", "mine_critical_strike_chance_+%", "mine_critical_strike_multiplier_+", "mine_laying_speed_+%", "mine_detonation_speed_+%", "mine_duration_+%", "number_of_additional_remote_mines_allowed")
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Character Traps and Mines are now invulnerable from taking damage for 2 seconds after they have been thrown.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* Fixed a bug which prevented [[Mana reservation|mana reserved]] by Mines to not correctly update with increases and reductions to [[mana reservation]].
}}
{{Version history table row|3.10.0|
* Base mine throwing time has been raised to 0.3 seconds (from 0.25).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.8.0|
* Mines are now thrown, rather than placed. Modifiers that previously affected your mine placement speed now instead affect your mine throwing speed.
* The first mine you detonate will detonate instantly.
* When detonating multiple mines, they are detonated in an accelerating sequence based on distance from your initial detonation target.
* All mine skills, except those supported by Blastchain Mine Support, now have an aura component that is active while they are placed but not detonated. These auras can stack (up to a limit), and are affected by aura modifiers.
* Each mine you throw now reserves a flat amount of mana based on the cost of the skill (and therefore affected by Support gems).
* You can now have up to 15 mines active at once by default (from 5).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.3.0|
* Modifiers to skill duration no longer modify the duration of traps, totems or mines, but will continue to modify the duration of skills cast by traps, totems and mines if those skills have a duration.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* Traps and Mines are now invulnerable while they are arming and invulnerable while they are casting their skill. This means a trap thrown directly onto a monster who will detonate it cannot be destroyed before it detonates.
* You can now queue up a 'detonate' action for Mines while they are arming to detonate them as soon as they have finished arming.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.3.1|
* Creating multiple mines with [[Vaal skill]]s now correctly consumes souls for each use and checks that you have enough souls.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.2.2|
* Fixed a bug where players could have multiple Offerings active at once through the use of traps, totems or mines.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
